# Clips are generated by .github/workflows/voice-prompts.yml from tools/prompts.tsv
set(clips ready need_wifi need_api_key wifi_lost wifi_back no_internet gemini_failed
          saved settings_saved deleted error speaker_test)
set(clip_files)
foreach(c ${clips})
    list(APPEND clip_files "clips/${c}.pcm")
endforeach()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "prompts.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    PRIV_REQUIRES audio settings
    EMBED_FILES ${clip_files}
)
